spans.s:
भृकुंश भृकुंश or भृकुंस or भृकुं-
सक, अस्, m. a male actor or dancer in female attire
[cf. भ्रूकुंश, भ्रुकुंश, भ्रकुंश].

भृकुटि भृ-कुटि, इस्, or भृ-कुटी, f. (cor-
rupted fr. भ्रू-कुटि, see भ्रू), contraction or knit-
ting of the eyebrow, a frown; (ई), f. a species of
frog; (with Jainas) N. of a goddess executing the
commands of the eighth Arhat of the present Ava-
sarpiṇī; (इस्), m. (with Jainas) N. of the servant of
the twentieth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī.
—भृकुटि-मुख = भ्रुकुटि-मुख, q. v.

भृक्ष् भृक्ष् or भ्रक्ष्, cl. 1. P. A.
भृक्षति, -ते, भ्रक्षति, -ते, &c.,
various reading for rt. भक्ष्, q. v.

भृक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, roasted, fried; [cf. Lat.
frictus, frixus.]
